articles.title: US SEC follows CFTC in staff guidance for crypto
articles.snippet: With the failed cloture vote on the CLARITY Act, the SEC announced updates on how federal securities laws could apply to token issuers, following similar guidance from the CFTC.

articles.title: Bybit accepts Franklin Templeton tokenized funds as trading collateral
articles.snippet: Eligible institutions can pledge Benji-issued fund shares for stablecoin credit lines while keeping the underlying assets in off-exchange custody.

articles.title: Altseason is coming — and traders are more discerning this time
articles.snippet: Altseason is almost here and early signs suggest traders are becoming more selective, with capital flowing into revenue-generating protocols across a number of different narratives.

articles.title: South Korea weighs crypto market makers after JPYC trades at 4 times peg
articles.snippet: Crypto market making is effectively restricted under South Korea’s manipulation rules, but regulators are reconsidering the approach after a JPYC spiked on Upbit this month.

articles.title: Newsom signs California ban on public officials issuing memecoins
articles.snippet: The law also restricts crypto companies from offering certain memecoins tied to public officials to California residents and takes effect for tokens issued from Jan. 1, 2027.
